method: Rows come from four sources fetched on 2026-11-02: ProSettings VALORANT list, SensLab VALORANT pro table (each row's own player-controlled source URL), specs.gg VALORANT profiles (team-tagged profiles = pro; profiles with no team = general, self-submitted), and replies in a VLR.gg forum thread that give rank, DPI and sens. cm360 = 914.4/(dpi*sens*0.07). Duplicates across sources are removed by normalised name (earlier source in the order above wins). Implausible rows (s800 = dpi*sens/800 > 1.2 or < 0.08) are excluded and counted.
